description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance and token count for four language models (LMs) across four benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, while the vertical axis on the left indicates the average performance percentage, and the vertical axis on the right shows the token count. The bars are color-coded to represent different LMs: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (blue), and CoUT (green). The performance percentages range from approximately 70% to 100%, and the token counts range from around 100 to 800. The highest average performance is observed in the CoUT model, with a performance of around 91.19% and a token count of approximately 354.46. The lowest average performance is seen in the CoT model, with a performance of about 80.89% and a token count of roughly 445.91. The token counts for the other models are distributed between these two extremes.
